styles.label: Beaches
styles.blurb: Swims at No. 1 Bathing Beach and the old pier.

styles.label: Culture
styles.blurb: Brewery history, old German streets and seaside walks.

styles.label: Food
styles.blurb: Seafood, dumplings and cold Tsingtao beer.

stays.why: Walk to the pier, Zhanqiao, St. Michael's Cathedral and the beer museum. Best for first-timers without a car.
Modern seafront, malls and easy metro. Good base for the Olympic sailing centre and night views.
Quiet leafy streets of old villas between two beaches. Romantic and close to the coast walks.
Mountain and coastal scenery, tea villages and quieter beaches. Far from the city centre; check transport on the day.

food: Eat seafood by weight at markets and small restaurants; agree the price before cooking.
Try Qingdao dumplings (mackerel or prawn filling) and grilled squid from street stalls.
Drink cold Tsingtao beer; the annual beer festival runs in summer — check dates on the day.
Breakfast like a local: youtiao fried dough sticks and soy milk from corner shops.
Budget roughly ¥30–80 per person for a casual meal; seafood dinners cost more.
more_time: Take a day trip to Laoshan for mountain trails and coastal views; check bus and ticket details on the day.
Ride the coastal path and beaches north of the city if the weather is clear.
Spend an afternoon in the old German concession streets for architecture and cafés.

recommend.why: Two nights covers the Old Town, the coast and a seafood-and-beer evening; add a night for Laoshan.

month_notes: January: cold, highs near 4°C. Pack a warm coat; few rainy days.
February: still cold, around 6°C. Quiet sights and low prices.
March: cool at 11°C; a light jacket is enough for walking.
April: mild at 16°C; good for the old streets and coast walks.
May: pleasant 20°C; beaches start to feel inviting.
June: warm at 24°C with more rain days; bring a light rain layer.
July: hot and humid, 27°C, wettest month. Book indoor plans too.
August: hottest at 29°C with frequent rain; go out early or late.
September: warm 26°C and drier; a strong month for the beach.
October: mild 20°C; comfortable for walking and sightseeing.
November: cooler at 13°C; pack layers and expect some rain.
December: cold near 6°C; festive city lights and few rainy days.

climate_guide.summary: Four clear seasons: cold dry winters, mild springs and autumns, and a hot, humid, rainy summer.

items.title: Best time: May to June and September to October
items.text: Mild days around 20–26°C, good for beaches, old streets and coastal walks.

items.title: Hot, humid summer (July–August)
items.text: Highs of 27–29°C with 12–13 rain days a month. Plan indoor stops and early outings.

items.title: Rain peaks in midsummer
items.text: July and August are the wettest; carry a compact umbrella and check forecasts on the day.

items.title: Cold winters (December–February)
items.text: Highs of 4–6°C and lows near or below freezing. Bring a warm coat and layers.

items.title: Sea breezes
items.text: The coast stays breezy; a light windproof layer helps even in summer evenings.

items.title: What to pack
items.text: Light clothes and sunscreen for summer, a rain layer in July–August, and warm layers for winter.

transit.best: Metro for most trips; ride-hailing apps for the airport and late nights.

modes.text: Fares ¥2–8; trains run about 06:00–22:30. Line 8 links the airport to Qingdao North Railway Station.
Buses cost ¥1, or ¥2 with air conditioning; up to ¥6 for far suburbs.
Didi and other apps work well; pick up at the Ground Transportation Center. Taxis are plentiful but hard to flag in peak summer — use an app.
Possible, but city traffic and parking are a hassle. Check licence rules on the day.
Good in the Old Town and along the coast. Cycling is hilly and risky; shared bikes are scarce.
